selected_memories.text: Official revision: for the chain involving DEX-84 and LOQ-72, the accepted terminal code is CYN-78; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active ZUM-85 is present, it produces DEX-84.
Official rule: activating DEX-67 converts ZUM-85 into its active form.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with LOQ-72 is HAP-32.
When DEX-84 encounters LOQ-72, the validated terminal code becomes CYN-78.
Official rule: activating TEK-61 converts RAV-65 into its active form.
When active RAV-65 is present, it produces XAN-17.
Official revision: for the chain involving XAN-17 and GOL-77, the accepted terminal code is LOQ-80; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with GOL-77 is BIR-49.
When XAN-17 encounters GOL-77, the validated terminal code becomes LOQ-80.
Official revision: for the chain involving WAM-62 and SIV-67, the accepted terminal code is SIV-13; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active WAM-49 is present, it produces WAM-62.
Official rule: activating GOL-79 converts WAM-49 into its active form.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with SIV-67 is KEL-36.
When WAM-62 encounters SIV-67, the validated terminal code becomes SIV-13.
